name: Bifuka (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Bifuka town emblem in red and white: a red ring topped by a bar, enclosing a white ring.
history: Municipal flag of Bifuka, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 1948.

features.role: Bifuka town emblem — a red ring topped by a bar, enclosing a white ring
